info.name: TalentAI Backend API
info.description: Complete API collection for TalentAI Backend with 256+ endpoints - All endpoints properly grouped by module with variables for base_url and authentication token

variable.description: API Base URL - Change to your server URL
JWT Authentication Token - Get from login/auth endpoint
API Key for API key authenticated endpoints

item.name: POST /auth/register
item.description: Create a new user and profile (Candidate or Company role), send OTP. For Candidates, resume is analyzed automatically.

item.name: POST /auth/
item.description: Send OTP to an existing user for login

item.name: POST /auth/analyze
item.description: Analyze a stored resume and extract information via Bedrock

item.name: POST /auth/verify-otp
item.description: Verify OTP code to activate/validate account

item.name: POST /auth/resend-otp
item.description: Send a new OTP code to user via email (valid for 5 minutes)

item.name: GET /auth/check-role
item.description: Return the role of a user by email

item.name: GET /api/api-keys
item.description: List all API keys for the user

item.name: GET /api/api-keys/:id
item.description: Get details of an API key

item.name: POST /api/api-keys/:id/regenerate
item.description: Regenerate an API key (create a new one)

item.name: POST /admin/backups/restore/:backupName
item.description: Restore database from a specific backup (WARNING: overwrites current database)

item.name: DELETE /admin/backups/delete/:backupName
item.description: Delete a specific backup by name

item.name: POST /campaigns/:campaignId/participants
item.description: Add a participant to a campaign

item.name: GET /campaigns/:campaignId/participants
item.description: Retrieve all participants in a campaign

item.name: GET /participants/token/:token
item.description: Retrieve participant by anonymous token (public for anonymous campaigns)

item.name: GET /candidate-post-step-progress/getUserProgress
item.description: Get progression of the current user

item.name: GET /candidate-post-step-progress/candidate/:candidateId/post/:postId
item.description: Get progress by candidate and post

item.name: PUT /candidate-post-step-progress/candidate/:candidateId/post/:postId
item.description: Update progress by candidate and post

item.name: DELETE /candidate-post-step-progress/candidate/:candidateId/post/:postId
item.description: Delete progress by candidate and post

item.name: POST /chat/conversations/unarchive-all
item.description: Remove current user from archivedBy on all conversations

item.name: GET /admin/companies/:companyId/permissions
item.description: Retrieve permissions for a specific company

item.name: POST /admin/companies/:companyId/permissions
item.description: Update permissions for a specific company

item.name: GET /company-invitations/details/:invitationId
item.description: Get invitation details by ID (public for unauthenticated users)

item.name: POST /company-invitations/respondInvitation/:invitationId
item.description: Accept or reject an invitation (public for invitee)

item.name: POST /company-invitations/sentInvitation
item.description: Add a new employee to a Company account

item.name: POST /company-invitations/resendInvitation/:invitationId
item.description: Resend an invitation (regenerate token and reset expiration)

item.name: GET /company-invitations/myInvitations
item.description: Get all invitations for companies owned by current user

item.name: GET /company-invitations/byDepartment/:departmentId
item.description: Get all pending invitations for a specific department

item.name: GET /company-memberships/memberships/stats
item.description: Get statistics for a company's memberships (counts by role/status)

item.name: GET /company-memberships/memberships
item.description: Get all memberships for a company owned by the user

item.name: POST /cv-analysis
item.description: Create a new CV analysis record

item.name: GET /cv-analysis
item.description: Get all CV analyses with pagination and filtering

item.name: GET /cv-analysis/:id
item.description: Get a specific CV analysis by ID

item.name: PUT /cv-analysis/:id
item.description: Update a CV analysis by ID

item.name: DELETE /cv-analysis/:id
item.description: Delete a CV analysis by ID

item.name: GET /cv-analysis/user/:userId
item.description: Get all CV analyses for a specific user

item.name: GET /cv-analysis/company/:companyId
item.description: Get all CV analyses for a specific company

item.name: GET /cv-analysis/seniority/:seniority
item.description: Get CV analyses filtered by seniority level

item.name: GET /dashboard/getAllUsers
item.description: Retrieve the list of all users

item.name: GET /dashboard/statsCards
item.description: Retrieve statistics displayed as cards on dashboard

item.name: GET /dashboard/getUserCountsByDay
item.description: Retrieve daily evolution of user count

item.name: GET /dashboard/downloadUserExcel
item.description: Download an Excel export of users

item.name: GET /departments
item.description: List company departments with optional name search and pagination

item.name: GET /internal-campaigns/employee/:userId
item.description: Get campaigns for a specific user (campaigns where user is participant)

item.name: GET /internal-campaigns/employee/:userId/metrics
item.description: Get employee campaign metrics (total, invited, inProgress, completed)

item.name: GET /internal-campaigns/:campaignId/participants
item.description: Get campaign participants (accessible to authenticated employees who participate)

item.name: GET /interview-details
item.description: Retrieve the list of all interviews

item.name: POST /interview-details
item.description: Add interview details (converts new format to old)

item.name: GET /job-applications/post/:postId
item.description: Get all applications for a post (public)

item.name: GET /job-applications/candidate/my
item.description: Get all applications for authenticated candidate

item.name: GET /job-applications/candidate/my/stats
item.description: Get dashboard stats for authenticated candidate

item.name: GET /job-applications/company/my
item.description: Get all applications for authenticated company

item.name: POST /job-applications/contact-candidate
item.description: Send a direct email to a candidate

item.name: GET /job-applications/post/:postId/summary
item.description: Flat summary list for a post (company only)

item.name: GET /job-applications/company/my/summary
item.description: Flat summary list for all company applications

item.name: GET /job-applications/company/my/metrics
item.description: Get application metrics for authenticated company

item.name: GET /job-applications/company/my/cvs/download
item.description: Download all matching CVs as a ZIP

item.name: GET /notification-system/GetMyNotification
item.description: List system notifications for current user

item.name: PATCH /notification-system/mark-all-read
item.description: Mark all notifications as read for user

item.name: PATCH /notification-system/archive-all
item.description: Archive all notifications for current user

item.name: POST /payments/verify
item.description: Verify and update payment status after successful checkout

item.name: GET /pipeline-interview/params/:jobId/:stepNumber
item.description: Get interview parameters for a specific step

item.name: GET /pipeline-interview/steps/:jobId
item.description: Get all interview steps for a job

item.name: PUT /pipeline-interview/progress/update-step
item.description: Update step status after interview completion

item.name: GET /post/search
item.description: Return all posts with search, filters and pagination (public)

item.name: GET /post/public-stats
item.description: Return public statistics (number of users, posts, companies)

item.name: GET /post/my-posts
item.description: Posts of current user (requires read:posts scope)

item.name: GET /post/metrics
item.description: Return post metrics (total, active, draft, expired, closed, cancelled)

item.name: GET /post/adsPost
item.description: 3 posts suggested from top 3 profile skills + pagination

item.name: GET /post/interview-config/:jobId
item.description: Get interview configuration for job-based HR interview (prompt flow)

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/check/:postId
item.description: Check if candidate has assessment for post

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/matching/:postId
item.description: Get matching details for candidate and post

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/company/mine
item.description: Get all assessments for authenticated company

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/company/mine/metrics
item.description: Get interview metrics for authenticated company

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/company/mine/kpi/unreviewed-48h
item.description: Get KPI count of unreviewed AI interviews > 48h

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/company/mine/kpi/unreviewed-48h/details
item.description: Get details of unreviewed AI interviews > 48h

item.name: GET /post-interview-assessments/candidate/my
item.description: Get all assessments for a candidate

item.name: GET /profile/getSoftSkills
item.description: Get soft skills of current user

item.name: GET /profile/getSoftSkillsById/:userId
item.description: Get soft skills by user ID

item.name: GET /profile/:profileId/payments
item.description: Get all payments for a profile

item.name: GET /profile/:userId
item.description: Get profile by ID (public - no auth required)

item.name: GET /skill-interview-assessments/:id
item.description: Get skill interview assessment by ID

item.name: GET /subscriptions/active
item.description: Get active subscription for a company

item.name: GET /subscriptions
item.description: Get all subscriptions for a company

item.name: GET /subscriptions/:subscriptionId/details
item.description: Get detailed subscription info with usage stats

item.name: GET /subscriptions/:companyProfileId/check-limit/:limitType
item.description: Check if company can perform an action

item.name: POST /subscriptions/:subscriptionId/renew
item.description: Renew subscription (create new from same plan)

item.name: GET /team-chat/conversations/:conversationId
item.description: Get team chat conversation by ID

item.name: PUT /team-chat/conversations/:conversationId/read
item.description: Mark team chat conversation as read

item.name: POST /todo/profile
item.description: Generate a todo list for user profile

item.name: GET /todo/profile
item.description: Retrieve the user profile todo list
